nodes.label: Feature 1: auto-optimize on upload
nodes.rationale: Runs in wp_handle_upload, after the file is moved into uploads/ but before wp_insert_attachment, so WordPress creates the attachment as native .webp and generates every subsize as WebP itself. Consequence: zero URL rewriting needed.

nodes.label: Feature 2: individual / bulk optimization
nodes.rationale: Retro-fits images already in the Media Library that have references scattered across posts, meta and options; needs URL rewriting, which is why AttachmentConverter plus Rewrite/ is ten times the size of Upload/Interceptor.php.

nodes.label: Decision: no AVIF, WebP only
nodes.rationale: AVIF encoding is 5-10x slower, punishing across a large library. Tracked in future-specs/avif-support.md.

nodes.label: Decision: no client-side conversion
nodes.rationale: Cimo's canvas.toBlob approach is fast but breaks in Safari, needs an open browser tab, and cannot do bulk without downloading and re-uploading every image.

nodes.label: Decision: no external HTTP requests of any kind
nodes.rationale: No telemetry, no phone-home, no licence check.

nodes.label: Decision: no non-destructive mode
nodes.rationale: Originals are replaced and URLs rewritten by explicit product decision; the safety net is backups + retention + restore, not a parallel-file mode.

nodes.label: Naming rules — single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Slug, namespace, text domain, constants prefix, option prefix, REST namespace, DB table, backup directory, React mount point and CSS class prefix are all fixed to swift-image-optimizer / SwiftImageOptimizer\ / SWIFT_IMAGE_OPTIMIZER_ / sio-.

nodes.label: Tech constraints: PHP 7.4+, WP 6.2+, no Composer runtime dep
nodes.rationale: Verified: every file parses under PHP 7.4, 8.2 and 8.4. WP 6.2 minimum because the admin bundle uses createRoot from @wordpress/element (React 18). @wordpress/scripts is a dev dependency only.
